items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:199:1
items.html:
The inheritance of AVI: an illumination is drawn to him in his two faces etc. but from the Daat it is drawn into the body, within the halls and chambers, which are VAK [six ends]. That is, as written above (in this part, item 94), that the brain of Hochma has no expansion except until the brain, and this indicates a very great diminution of light, on account of the abundance of its concealment.
See there. And this is because the Mochin of HB are corrected in the Mem of Tzelem [image], as is known. And the entire revelation of the Hochma of ZA is in the Daat, which expands from above downward into the Guf [body] and fills the Adrin and the Achsadrin. Adrin means inner chambers, and they hint at the HGT of ZA until his Chazeh [chest], where the Hassadim are still in concealment; and Achsadrin means outer chambers, and they hint at the NHY from his Chazeh downward, where the Hassadim are revealed in the illumination of Hochma. Therefore he divides the expansion of the Daat into two discernments, into Adrin and Achsadrin, since they are two distinct bestowals, as explained.
